standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there. You look lost, are you okay?

options.text: I'm looking for a stronghold or something...

steps.player: I'm looking for a stronghold or something...

steps.npc: Ahh... the Stronghold of Security. It's down there.

steps.text: Litara point's on the hole in the ground that looks like you could squeeze through.

steps.player: Looks kind of... deep and dark.

steps.npc: Yeah... tell that to my brother, he still hasn't come back.
He's an explorer too. When the miner fell down that hole he'd made and came back babbling about doors, questions and treasure, my brother went to explore. No-one has seen him since.
Lots of people have been down there, but none of them have seen him, Let me know if you do, will you?

steps.player: I'll certainly keep my eyes open.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-spok.npc: Hello there. You look lost, are you okay?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-spok.player: I travelled to the bottom of the stronghold, and I emerge victorious!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-spok.npc: Well done! You didn't happen to find my brother?
I sense bad news. It's okay, he's been gone so long. I believe I've moved on.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-spok.player: Well, at least he died doing what he loved.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-spok.npc: True, I will raise a drink for him tonight, he was a good man, even if he was a pacifist.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-spok.player: As will I. See you around, Litara.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-alre.npc: Hello there. You look lost, are you okay?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-alre.player: I travelled to the bottom of the stronghold, and I emerge victorious!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-alre.npc: I am glad the challenges of the stronghold have been overcome; it feels like my brother has somehow been avenged.
